sampleData.question: What was the operating margin trend in Q3 and which division led profitability?
sampleData.answer: The operating margin reached 18.7% in Q3 2026, driven by recurring SaaS leverage and improved cloud infrastructure efficiency [[s.1]]. Enterprise Platform services delivered an operating contribution of $42.6M, up 22% year-over-year [[s.2]].
sampleData.source1: Operating margin expanded to 18.7% in Q3 2026, driven by recurring SaaS leverage and improved cloud infrastructure efficiency. Total gross profit reached $88.2M against revenues of $142.1M.
sampleData.source2: Enterprise Platform delivered $42.6M in operating contribution, up 22% year-over-year. International business units contributed $18.4M while consumer segments remained flat.
